proposal.recommendation: At the next verified flat and owned-order-free boundary, cut over to a successor profile that removes long authority from the SPCX cash-open provider while retaining its short authority and leaving every BTC and HYPE route unchanged.
proposal.why_now: The first exact V56 SPCX long lost $42.08606; the frozen development long side had only 3 wins in 9 trades, two of three folds lost, and stress net became -$75.04559 after removing its largest winner. The pooled route was promoted primarily by the materially stronger short side.
evidence_reviewed: Exact V56 SPCX decision, fill, protection, stop execution, costs, excursion, and final flat lifecycle audit
Frozen 2026-06-08 through 2026-07-13 SPCX development replay with nominal, stress, side, fold, and largest-winner diagnostics
Preregistered 40, 60, and 80 bps long fixed-target development challenger
Preregistered nine-trade causal long entry-quality diagnosis with technical-path attribution
proposal.observed_problem_or_opportunity: Bidirectional pooled economics masked a brittle long side: long stress PF was 1.4133 only because of one $192.8451 winner, PF without that winner was 0.7367, fold nets were -$44.6464, +$319.8025, and -$139.3610, and the first exact forward long lost. The live reason says reversal confirmed although the mechanism does not require an opening-bar reversal.
proposal.applicable_market_regime: All observed regimes; this is a side-specific evidence and authority correction, not a directional macro forecast.
alternatives_considered: Continue both SPCX sides unchanged and collect more losses or wins
Reduce only SPCX long size without evidence for a calibrated fraction
Require a positive opening-bar reversal, which left one losing development trade and today also lost
Require negative top-10 imbalance, a post-hoc five-trade subset whose wins cluster in one middle fold and whose later two trades both lost
Remove the entire SPCX route, which would discard the materially stronger short-side development evidence
proposal.proposed_live_change: Create and verify a new successor config with the SPCX provider sides set to [short] and executable direction limited to short; do not edit or hot-reload the active V56 file. Cut over only while venue and all strategy ledgers are flat and owned-order-free. Preserve BTC and HYPE routes, leverage, margin, stops, targets, and hold policies exactly.
proposal.expected_upside: Prevents a weak, largest-winner-dependent long side from taking another approximately $5,000-notional 80-bps-stop exposure while preserving the route's stronger short-side opportunity and all other V56 opportunities.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: Nine development longs plus one forward long remain a small sample and disabling may miss a future winner
Four of nine development long lifecycles have unresolved entry risk slices
The short side has no exact V56 resolved lifecycle yet and its own profitability remains provisional
A malformed successor could accidentally remove the whole provider or retain hidden long authority
Restarting away from a non-flat or order-held state could orphan risk and is prohibited
validation_completed: V56 first lifecycle reconciles exactly to one long stop loss and final flat/order-free state
Development long side is separated from pooled route economics
All three chronological long fold outcomes and largest-winner sensitivity are explicit
Fixed 40, 60, and 80 bps target family was preregistered and rejected after exact stress replay
Causal opening gap, reversal, spread, imbalance, trade count, volume, and L2 snapshot features reconcile one-to-one for all nine long entries
No entry filter or live mutation was selected from the descriptive diagnosis
validation_still_required: Explicit human approval of this exact side-authority proposal
TDD successor config proving exact BTC and HYPE identity preservation and SPCX short-only authority
Fresh flat, owned-order-free, venue/ledger/accounting preflight before cutover
Poststart acceptance proving no SPCX long executable scope or long action and intact SPCX short exit contract
Prospective exact-cost SPCX short lifecycle collection before any claim that the short side is profitable
success_metrics: Zero executable or manually routable SPCX long scope in the successor
Exact SPCX short route remains present with 80-bps stop and prior-cash-close target
All BTC and HYPE route identities and execution contracts remain byte-equivalent in parsed configuration
Cutover occurs only flat and order-free with healthy checkpoint and zero faults
Every later SPCX short decision receives complete action or withholding and lifecycle accounting
failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any open position or owned order at the proposed cutover boundary
Any successor diff beyond SPCX long authority and version/accounting identity
Any SPCX long intent becomes routable after cutover
SPCX short route, stop, target anchor, or session-close fallback is missing or changed
Backend/checkpoint identity mismatch, stale telemetry, protection defect, or accounting reconciliation failure
